decisions.mcq_coverage_fix: C4 coverage bug FOUND+FIXED (2026-07-16). Narrow mcq filter `correct answer|explanation` was kind-blind and under-covered QBANK (PassMedicine) by ~63%: PassMedicine answer pages seldom print 'explanation' (106 pp) and state the key only in prose or as the peak peer-response %. Capture was ~2358 of ~5396 qbank Qs. FIX (kind-aware build_mcq via new _mcq_units): past_paper(Pastest)=per-page pages matching 'correct answer|explanation' (4279 self-contained answer pages; duplicate bare-question halves skipped); qbank(PassMedicine)=one UNIT per question = the 'Question N of M' page STITCHED with following continuation pages up to the next header (~5418 units; full stem+options+explanation+topic notes). qof_pages>=M per work => clean segmentation (at most minor over-split -> null, never under-merge). New mcq total ~9697 (was 6637). MCQ_SYS prompt updated: infer the answer letter from explanation prose; ignore peer-% as key; strip PassMed UI. _run_test now strided-samples across BOTH kinds so it validates qbank stitched-unit parsing + re-extrapolates cost.
